caption:
A single 3D animator brought this robot character to life, and the result speaks for itself.

Every joint moves with weight and intention. The "fallen angel" pose alone has artists online stunned. This is what modern animation tools in the right hands can produce: 10 seconds of footage that feels more alive than most big studio work.
